speaker: AI
text: Tell me about a project you're proud of.

speaker: CANDIDATE
text: I built a task tracker with a React front end and an Express API on Postgres. Users could create projects, assign tasks, and move them across a Kanban board. I added JWT authentication and wrote tests for the main endpoints.

speaker: AI
text: How did you structure the API?

speaker: CANDIDATE
text: I split it into routes, controllers, and a service layer. Controllers handled validation and status codes, and services talked to the database through an ORM. That kept the route files small and made the logic easier to test.

speaker: AI
text: What would you change if you built it again?

speaker: CANDIDATE
text: I would add pagination from the start, because the task list got slow once there were a few hundred rows. I would also add clearer error handling so the client gets a useful message instead of a generic 500.

speaker: AI
text: How do you test your code?

speaker: CANDIDATE
text: I write unit tests for the service functions and a few integration tests that hit the API with a test database. I try to cover edge cases like empty input and missing records, though I know the coverage is not complete.
